privileged_info_for_vlm: The Firefox Multi-Account Containers extension indicates active containers by placing a colored line at the top of the tab and displaying the container name on the right side of the address bar. The specific URLs required are https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open-source_intelligence (for Alpha/Red/Briefcase) and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Signals_intelligence (for Beta/Purple/Fingerprint).
